_profileUploadHint.title: Profile ZIP files
_profileUploadHint.text: Place the HomeConnect Local HASS ZIP files in the ioBroker file area, for example /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/files/0_userdata.0/. The adapter scans this folder for matching profile ZIP files. Restart the adapter instance or trigger a scan after uploading new ZIP files.

profilePath.label: Profile directory path
profilePath.help: Absolute container path to a directory containing Home Connect profile ZIP files. Default: /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/files/0_userdata.0/. A single ZIP or extracted profile directory is still supported. Restart the adapter instance or trigger a scan after uploading new ZIP files.

autoAddProfiles.label: Automatically add scanned profiles to the device table
autoAddProfiles.help: New profiles are added as disabled device suggestions. Existing enabled, host and haId values are preserved.

enableMdnsDiscovery.label: Enable mDNS discovery
enableMdnsDiscovery.help: Searches the local network for Home Connect appliances via _homeconnect._tcp.local. Depending on the enabled options, discovery can write discovery states, update hosts, and enable or add uniquely discovered appliances.

mdnsDiscoveryTimeout.label: mDNS discovery timeout in seconds
mdnsDiscoveryTimeout.help: How long each Home Connect mDNS discovery scan listens for responses.

autoUpdateDiscoveredHosts.label: Update hosts from discovered appliances
autoUpdateDiscoveredHosts.help: Automatically updates the host/IP address of existing configured appliances from safe mDNS matches.

autoAddDiscoveredDevices.label: Automatically enable/add discovered appliances
autoAddDiscoveredDevices.help: Automatically enables or adds uniquely discovered appliances to the device table when a matching profile ZIP is available.

watchdogHeartbeatIdleMinutes.label: Watchdog heartbeat idle threshold in minutes
watchdogHeartbeatIdleMinutes.help: The connection watchdog sends /ni/info only after this many minutes without any Home Connect traffic. Reconnect is attempted only if that heartbeat fails.

enableRawStates.label: Create raw UID states
enableRawStates.help: Creates debug states raw.uid_<uid> with raw Home Connect values.

devices.label: Appliances
devices.help: Only Enabled, Name and IP or host should normally be edited. The other columns are filled from the scanned profile ZIP files.
